state.task: Decide how to reconcile the Busan KTX station twin 2F with new layout evidence. Station frame: +u north, +v east. The main building spans v -50..12; the over-track box spans v 15..100, u -21..69.

facts.C1_board: Official on-site directory board, photographed 2026-04 (KORAIL; top of the board = east). It shows the 2F as one continuous concourse. The east edge has shops 7 크리스피크림, 8 카카오프렌즈, 9 떡공방 and 10 파스쿠찌, plus exits 9 and 10 leading to the covered deck to the North Port park. The round 종합안내소 is in the middle-west, with the void and 3F above it. 역무실, 매표창구 and 철도경찰서 are on the south side. The west side is the curved plaza-facade shop band (shops 17-31) with the plaza entrance. The 3F is an L: the food-court band over the east-edge shops, and a south wing.
facts.C2_kakao: Kakao map POIs (north-up screenshot, 20 m scale bar). 부산역관광안내소 is about 50 m east of the plaza-side shops (복순도가, 환공어묵), next to the rail lines. 크리스피크림/exit 10, 파스쿠찌/exit 9, 이디야 and 소미담 are 40-55 m further east. 부산옥 is about 35 m south-east of the info desk.
facts.C3_naver: Naver pins: tourist information center at (36,32); east-edge shops at v 91-94, inside the over-track box; plaza-side shops (SUBWAY, 소반한식, B&C bakery) at v -29..-35, inside the main building.
facts.C4_current_twin: The current twin, built from the 2022-video registration, places the circular info desk at (-41,-10), KAKAO FRIENDS at (-74,14.5) and exit 9 at (-68.8,23), all inside the main building and 70-90 m from the map positions. The over-track box interior is empty.
facts.C5_route_order: 2022-video route order: platform stairs, covered glazed deck over the tracks, exit 9, low-ceiling arcade with KAKAO FRIENDS, high lattice hall (3F balconies, escalator pair to 3F, green boards on a fascia), circular info desk, low arcade (B&C, Storyway), escalator down to 1F, plaza exits. This matches the board read east to west.
facts.C6_registration_basis: The registration comes from an SfM relative trajectory. Scale was set from an assumed 7 m 2F-1F rise, and the anchor from the 220 s 1F plaza exit. The filmed hall extents were then fitted inside the main-building shell. The original main-building interior has no partitions and a flat 23 m ceiling, so it could not refute that placement.
facts.C7_box: The box shell has its 2F at 7.0. Its west wall is open at 2F toward the main building (y 7-12, u -12..52). A low-roof L (south wing plus east band) and a raised 23-26 m roof over u 2..56, v 42..84 (the void) match the board 3F L.
facts.C8_heights: The registered hall roof members are about 11 m above the 2F floor. The box raised-roof underside is about 17 m above the box 2F. The original main-building interior ceiling is a flat slab 16 m above 2F.
facts.C9_view: At 98 s the 2022 video shows dense hillside housing through a high clerestory. Such hills exist both west (초량) and south-east (영도) of the station, so this does not decide the question.
